entry.title: AcusMagic Releases Figura Real-Time Cymatics Visualizer Plugin
entry.content:

AcusMagic has released Figura, an audio effect and standalone application that translates incoming audio signals into real-time cymatic figures. Utilizing modal simulation rather than simple beat-reactive animation, the software drives the eigenmodes of virtual plates and membranes using up to 32 partials of the sound source, forming Chladni patterns, liquid waves, and Lissajous curves.

The Live version features a dedicated projection window for external monitors, and the software allows users to export still images up to 4096 pixels and MP4 video recordings up to 4K resolution.
